changelog: Polish pass. Esc and Back no longer strand you: End Turn keeps working after you back out of its warning, the menu stays put, and a shop, camp, event or battle report can't be dismissed by accident (tap your own map node to reopen one). Cards now do what they say: upgraded Battlefield Commissions can be played, Forward Observer shells what it reveals, upgraded Focus Fire's mark holds, Demolition Charge only hits structures and vehicles, Mobilize spends 12 Momentum, upgraded Dig In gives +6, and sacrifices are final. Events no longer charge you for things that can't happen. Fixed units sharing a tile, a Power Plant pushed out of range at deployment, blank tiles in the card collection, and Forward Scouts now reveal every ? on the map. Cards you can't afford or can't play yet no longer light up.
